//: Every app that installs @mavenmm/dev-library. Single source of truth for rollouts — scripts/consumers.sh reads it, and so should you. Adding an app? Add it HERE, not to a script.
//paths: There are deliberately no local paths in this file. It used to carry a workspaceRoot plus a path per app, which was one person's directory tree committed to a shared repo — it resolved to nothing for everyone else, silently. scripts/discover.py now locates each checkout by matching its git origin against the repo URL below, scanning $MAVEN_WORKSPACE (default ~/mavenmm). Keep only facts that are true in EVERY clone: repo, pkgDir, defaultBranch, deploy, packageManager.
//newsletter: Dropped 2026-08-16 — newsletter no longer depends on the library (no reference in its package.json or package-lock.json). Re-add it here if it picks the widget back up.

apps.name: PAAB App
apps.notes: Highest feedback volume — the canary. Video enabled. npm 11.10.0, pinned in both volta and netlify.toml.

apps.name: Maven Home
apps.notes: Furthest behind (v0.5.2). Jumping forward also picks up mic verification (v0.7.0). Roll out ALONE so a failure isn't ambiguous. Pins no npm version anywhere, so CI falls back to Netlify's npm 10.x, which ignores min-release-age — the cooldown holds locally and not in the builds that ship. Pin npm >= 11.10.0 (verified: 11.10.0 holds a version back, 10.8.2 does not) in volta AND netlify.toml.

apps.name: Status Update
apps.notes: VITE_FEEDBACK_VIDEO not set locally — confirm it exists in the Netlify build env or the meter never renders. The only app on npm 12 (pinned in volta AND netlify.toml): it sets strict-allow-scripts, so it needs v0.7.1+, and allow-git=root, which makes the FIRST install after any tag bump fail as 'non-root' until the lockfile is hand-synced — recipe is in its .npmrc, and rollout.sh does it automatically.

apps.name: Maven Dashboard
apps.notes: Dep lives in ui/, not the repo root. Prod droplet historically failed on build-on-install — fine since v0.5.3 ships prebuilt dist/. A pnpm workspace pinned to pnpm@10.34.3 with `preinstall: only-allow pnpm`, so rollout.sh skips it — bump this one by hand with pnpm. Its build-script allowlist is allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml (which already lists @mavenmm/dev-library), not an npm allowScripts map.

apps.name: Copydeck
apps.notes: Deploys to a droplet via .github/workflows/deploy.yml on merge — NOT Netlify. The workflow only SSHes in and runs ~/copydeck-cms/deploy.sh, so the node/npm that installs is whatever the droplet has; it is not pinned in the repo. Dep lives in app/.

apps.name: Reference Anchor Library
apps.notes: Added in FB-034 at v0.7.1. Deploys to droplet 159.89.124.178 via .github/workflows/deploy.yml, which SSHes in and runs `npm ci` — so the lockfile, not a fresh resolve, decides what ships. Its app/.npmrc sets min-release-age=14 AND engine-strict=true, and engines pins npm >= 11.13.0: below that npm crashes preparing a git dependency under the cooldown (11.10.x/11.11.x on --min-release-age vs --before, 11.12.0 on --prefer-online vs --prefer-offline). Verified 2026-08-21: 11.13.0/11.16.0/11.19.0 all install and `npm ci` cleanly with the cooldown on. Rich text needs the tiptap peer deps, which this repo carries explicitly (copydeck got them free from its own editor).

worker.name: maven-feedback-worker
worker.notes: Consumes /core only. Task creation and the Teamwork/Vimeo/summary pipeline live here, so /core fixes reach ALL apps with this one deploy.
